lore:
Mochi woke up already soft. Somewhere between a riverbank nap and a snack break, the little otter decided the timeline needed more quiet joy.

Friends say Mochi always has something to share — a crumb, a giggle, a place to rest. Words come slowly; kindness comes first.

There is no rush in Mochi lore. Just warm fur, gentle eyes, and a promise that soft is enough. Entertainment only — not financial advice.
